texts.2ti.1.1: PABLO, apóstol de Jesucristo por la voluntad de Dios, según la promesa de la vida que es en Cristo Jesús,
texts.2ti.1.2: A Timoteo, amado hijo: Gracia, misericordia, y paz de Dios el Padre y de Jesucristo nuestro Señor.
texts.2ti.1.3: Doy gracias á Dios, al cual sirvo desde mis mayores con limpia conciencia, de que sin cesar tengo memoria de ti en mis oraciones noche y día;
texts.2ti.1.4: Deseando verte, acordándome de tus lágrimas, para ser lleno de gozo;
texts.2ti.1.5: Trayendo á la memoria la fe no fingida que hay en ti, la cual residió primero en tu abuela Loida, y en tu madre Eunice; y estoy cierto que en ti también.
texts.2ti.1.6: Por lo cual te aconsejo que despiertes el don de Dios, que está en ti por la imposición de mis manos.
texts.2ti.1.7: Porque no nos ha dado Dios el espíritu de temor, sino el de fortaleza, y de amor, y de templanza.
texts.2ti.1.8: Por tanto no te avergüences del testimonio de nuestro Señor, ni de mí, preso suyo; antes sé participante de los trabajos del evangelio según la virtud de Dios,
texts.2ti.1.9: Que nos salvó y llamó con vocación santa, no conforme á nuestras obras, mas según el intento suyo y gracia, la cual nos es dada en Cristo Jesús antes de los tiempos de los siglos,
texts.2ti.1.10: Mas ahora es manifestada por la aparición de nuestro Salvador Jesucristo, el cual quitó la muerte, y sacó á la luz la vida y la inmortalidad por el evangelio;
texts.2ti.1.11: Del cual yo soy puesto predicador, y apóstol, y maestro de los Gentiles.
texts.2ti.1.12: Por lo cual asimismo padezco esto: mas no me avergüenzo; porque yo sé á quien he creído, y estoy cierto que es poderoso para guardar mi depósito para aquel día.
texts.2ti.1.13: Retén la forma de las sanas palabras que de mi oíste, en la fe y amor que es en Cristo Jesús.
texts.2ti.1.14: Guarda el buen depósito por el Espíritu Santo que habita en nosotros.
texts.2ti.1.15: Ya sabes esto, que me han sido contrarios todos los que son en Asia, de los cuales son Figello y Hermógenes.
texts.2ti.1.16: Dé el Señor misericordia á la casa de Onesíforo; que muchas veces me refrigeró, y no se avergonzó de mi cadena:
texts.2ti.1.17: Antes, estando él en Roma, me buscó solícitamente, y me halló.
texts.2ti.1.18: Déle el Señor que halle misericordia cerca del Señor en aquel día. Y cuánto nos ayudó en Efeso, tú lo sabes mejor.
texts.2ti.2.1: PUES tú, hijo mío, esfuérzate en la gracia que es en Cristo Jesús.
texts.2ti.2.2: Y lo que has oído de mí entre muchos testigos, esto encarga á los hombres fieles que serán idóneos para enseñar también á otros.
texts.2ti.2.3: Tú pues, sufre trabajos como fiel soldado de Jesucristo.
texts.2ti.2.4: Ninguno que milita se embaraza en los negocios de la vida; á fin de agradar á aquel que lo tomó por soldado.
texts.2ti.2.5: Y aun también el que lidia, no es coronado si no lidiare legítimamente.
texts.2ti.2.6: El labrador, para recibir los frutos, es menester que trabaje primero.
texts.2ti.2.7: Considera lo que digo; y el Señor te dé entendimiento en todo.
texts.2ti.2.8: Acuérdate que Jesucristo, el cual fué de la simiente de David, resucitó de los muertos conforme á mi evangelio;
texts.2ti.2.9: En el que sufro trabajo, hasta las prisiones á modo de malhechor; mas la palabra de Dios no está presa.
texts.2ti.2.10: Por tanto, todo lo sufro por amor de los escogidos, para que ellos también consigan la salud que es en Cristo Jesús con gloria eterna.
texts.2ti.2.11: Es palabra fiel: Que si somos muertos con él, también viviremos con él:
texts.2ti.2.12: Si sufrimos, también reinaremos con él: si negáremos, él también nos negará:
texts.2ti.2.13: Si fuéremos infieles, él permanece fiel: no se puede negar á sí mismo.
texts.2ti.2.14: Recuérdales esto, protestando delante del Señor que no contiendan en palabras, lo cual para nada aprovecha, antes trastorna á los oyentes.
texts.2ti.2.15: Procura con diligencia presentarte á Dios aprobado, como obrero que no tiene de qué avergonzarse, que traza bien la palabra de verdad.
texts.2ti.2.16: Mas evita profanas y vanas parlerías; porque muy adelante irán en la impiedad.
texts.2ti.2.17: Y la palabra de ellos carcomerá como gangrena: de los cuales es Himeneo y Fileto;
texts.2ti.2.18: Que se han descaminado de la verdad, diciendo que la resurrección es ya hecha, y trastornan la fe de algunos.
texts.2ti.2.19: Pero el fundamento de Dios está firme, teniendo este sello: Conoce el Señor á los que son suyos; y: Apártese de iniquidad todo aquel que invoca el nombre de Cristo.
texts.2ti.2.20: Mas en una casa grande, no solamente hay vasos de oro y de plata, sino también de madera y de barro: y asimismo unos para honra, y otros para deshonra.
texts.2ti.2.21: Así que, si alguno se limpiare de estas cosas, será vaso para honra, santificado, y útil para los usos del Señor, y aparejado para todo buena obra.
texts.2ti.2.22: Huye también los deseos juveniles; y sigue la justicia, la fe, la caridad, la paz, con los que invocan al Señor de puro corazón.
texts.2ti.2.23: Empero las cuestiones necias y sin sabiduría desecha, sabiendo que engendran contiendas.
texts.2ti.2.24: Que el siervo del Señor no debe ser litigioso, sino manso para con todos, apto para enseñar, sufrido;
texts.2ti.2.25: Que con mansedumbre corrija á los que se oponen: si quizá Dios les dé que se arrepientan para conocer la verdad,
texts.2ti.2.26: Y se zafen del lazo del diablo, en que están cuativos á voluntad de él.
texts.2ti.3.1: ESTO también sepas, que en los postreros días vendrán tiempos peligrosos:
texts.2ti.3.2: Que habrá hombres amadores de sí mismos, avaros, vanagloriosos, soberbios, detractores, desobedientes á los padres, ingratos, sin santidad,
texts.2ti.3.3: Sin afecto, desleales, calumniadores, destemplados, crueles, aborrecedores de lo bueno,
texts.2ti.3.4: Traidores, arrebatados, hinchados, amadores de los deleites más que de Dios;
texts.2ti.3.5: Teniendo apariencia de piedad, mas habiendo negado la eficacia de ella: y á éstos evita.
texts.2ti.3.6: Porque de éstos son los que se entran por las casas, y llevan cautivas las mujercillas cargadas de pecados, llevadas de diversas concupiscencias;
texts.2ti.3.7: Que siempre aprenden, y nunca pueden acabar de llegar al conocimiento de la verdad.
texts.2ti.3.8: Y de la manera que Jannes y Jambres resistieron á Moisés, así también estos resisten á la verdad; hombres corruptos de entendimiento, réprobos acerca de la fe.
texts.2ti.3.9: Mas no prevalecerán; porque su insensatez será manifiesta á todos, como también lo fué la de aquéllos.
texts.2ti.3.10: Pero tú has comprendido mi doctrina, instrucción, intento, fe, largura de ánimo, caridad, paciencia,
texts.2ti.3.11: Persecuciones, aflicciones, cuales me sobrevinieron en Antioquía, en Iconio, en Listra, cuales persecuciones he sufrido; y de todas me ha librado el Señor.
texts.2ti.3.12: Y también todos los que quieren vivir píamente en Cristo Jesús, padecerán persecución.
texts.2ti.3.13: Mas los malos hombres y los engañadores, irán de mal en peor, engañando y siendo engañados.
texts.2ti.3.14: Empero persiste tú en lo que has aprendido y te persuadiste, sabiendo de quién has aprendido;
texts.2ti.3.15: Y que desde la niñez has sabido las Sagradas Escrituras, las cuales te pueden hacer sabio para la salud por la fe que es en Cristo Jesús.
texts.2ti.3.16: Toda Escritura es inspirada divinamente y útil para enseñar, para redargüir, para corregir, para instituir en justicia,
texts.2ti.3.17: Para que el hombre de Dios sea perfecto, enteramente instruído para toda buena obra.
texts.2ti.4.1: REQUIERO yo pues delante de Dios, y del Señor Jesucristo, que ha de juzgar á los vivos y los muertos en su manifestación y en su reino.
texts.2ti.4.2: Que prediques la palabra; que instes á tiempo y fuera de tiempo; redarguye, reprende; exhorta con toda paciencia y doctrina.
texts.2ti.4.3: Porque vendrá tiempo cuando ni sufrirán la sana doctrina; antes, teniendo comezón de oir, se amotonarán maestros conforme á sus concupiscencias,
texts.2ti.4.4: Y apartarán de la verdad el oído y se volverán á las fábulas.
texts.2ti.4.5: Pero tú vela en todo, soporta las aflicciones, haz la obra de evangelista, cumple tu ministerio.
texts.2ti.4.6: Porque yo ya estoy para ser ofrecido, y el tiempo de mi partida está cercano.
texts.2ti.4.7: He peleado la buena batalla, he acabado la carrera, he guardado la fe.
texts.2ti.4.8: Por lo demás, me está guardada la corona de justicia, la cual me dará el Señor, juez justo, en aquel día; y no sólo á mí, sino también á todos los que aman su venida.
texts.2ti.4.10: Porque Demas me ha desamparado, amando este siglo, y se ha ido á Tesalónica; Crescente á Galacia, Tito á Dalmacia.
texts.2ti.4.11: Lucas solo está conmigo. Toma á Marcos, y traéle contigo; porque me es útil para el ministerio.
texts.2ti.4.13: Trae, cuando vinieres, el capote que dejé en Troas en casa de Carpo: y los libros, mayormente los pergaminos.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alejandro el calderero me ha causado muchos males: el Señor le pague conforme á sus hechos.
texts.2ti.4.15: Guárdate tú también de él; que en grande manera ha resistido á nuestras palabras.
texts.2ti.4.16: En mi primera defensa ninguno me ayudó, antes me desampararon todos: no les sea imputado.
texts.2ti.4.17: Mas el Señor me ayudó, y me esforzó para que por mí fuese cumplida la predicación, y todos los Gentiles oyesen; y fuí librado de la boca del león.
texts.2ti.4.18: Y el Señor me librará de toda obra mala, y me preservará para su reino celestial: al cual sea gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
texts.2ti.4.19: Saluda á Prisca y á Aquila, y á la casa de Onesíforo.
texts.2ti.4.20: Erasto se quedó en Corinto; y á Trófimo dejé en Mileto enfermo.
texts.2ti.4.21: Procura venir antes del invierno. Eubulo te saluda, y Pudente, y Lino, y Claudia, y todos los hermanos.
texts.2ti.4.22: El Señor Jesucristo sea con tu espíritu. La gracia sea con vosotros. Amén. {epístola á Timoteo, el cual fué el primer obispo ordenado en Efeso, fué escrita de Roma, cuando Pablo fué presentado la segunda vez á César Nerón.}

texts.2ti.1.1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
texts.2ti.1.2: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.2ti.1.3: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day
texts.2ti.1.4: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
texts.2ti.1.5: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.
texts.2ti.1.6: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.
texts.2ti.1.7: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
texts.2ti.1.8: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;
texts.2ti.1.9: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
texts.2ti.1.10: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
texts.2ti.1.11: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.
texts.2ti.1.12: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.
texts.2ti.1.13: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.1.14: That good thing which was committed unto [thee] guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.
texts.2ti.1.15: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
texts.2ti.1.16: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;
texts.2ti.1.17: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me
texts.2ti.1.18: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
texts.2ti.2.1: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.2.2: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
texts.2ti.2.3: Suffer hardship with [me], as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.2.4: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of [this] life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
texts.2ti.2.5: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowded, except he have contended lawfully.
texts.2ti.2.6: The husbandmen that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.
texts.2ti.2.7: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.
texts.2ti.2.8: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:
texts.2ti.2.9: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.
texts.2ti.2.10: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
texts.2ti.2.11: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:
texts.2ti.2.12: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:
texts.2ti.2.13: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.
texts.2ti.2.14: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging [them] in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.
texts.2ti.2.15: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.
texts.2ti.2.16: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,
texts.2ti.2.17: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: or whom is Hymenaeus an Philetus;
texts.2ti.2.18: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.
texts.2ti.2.19: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.
texts.2ti.2.20: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.
texts.2ti.2.21: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master's use, prepared unto every good work.
texts.2ti.2.22: after righteousness, faith, love, pace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
texts.2ti.2.23: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.
texts.2ti.2.24: And the Lord's servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,
texts.2ti.2.25: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,
texts.2ti.2.26: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.
texts.2ti.3.1: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.
texts.2ti.3.2: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
texts.2ti.3.3: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,
texts.2ti.3.4: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
texts.2ti.3.5: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power therefore. From these also turn away.
texts.2ti.3.6: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,
texts.2ti.3.7: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
texts.2ti.3.8: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth. Men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.
texts.2ti.3.9: But they shall proceed no further. For their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.
texts.2ti.3.10: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,
texts.2ti.3.11: persecutions, sufferings. What things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.
texts.2ti.3.12: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
texts.2ti.3.13: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
texts.2ti.3.14: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them.
texts.2ti.3.15: And that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.3.16: Every scripture inspired of God [is] also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness.
texts.2ti.3.17: That the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
texts.2ti.4.1: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:
texts.2ti.4.2: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.
texts.2ti.4.3: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;
texts.2ti.4.4: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.
texts.2ti.4.5: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.
texts.2ti.4.6: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.
texts.2ti.4.7: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:
texts.2ti.4.8: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.
texts.2ti.4.9: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:
texts.2ti.4.10: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
texts.2ti.4.11: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.
texts.2ti.4.12: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.
texts.2ti.4.13: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:
texts.2ti.4.15: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.
texts.2ti.4.16: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.
texts.2ti.4.17: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might me fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
texts.2ti.4.18: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom [be] the glory forever and ever. Amen.
texts.2ti.4.19: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
texts.2ti.4.20: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.
texts.2ti.4.21: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
texts.2ti.4.22: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.

texts.2ti.1.1: Paul, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, par la volonté de Dieu, pour annoncer la promesse de la vie qui est en Jésus-Christ,
texts.2ti.1.2: Timothée, mon enfant bien-aimé: que la grâce, la miséricorde et la paix te soient données de la part de Dieu le Père et de Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur!
texts.2ti.1.3: Je rends grâces à Dieu, que mes ancêtres ont servi, et que je sers avec une conscience pure, de ce que nuit et jour je me souviens continuellement de toi dans mes prières,
texts.2ti.1.4: me rappelant tes larmes, et désirant te voir afin d'être rempli de joie,
texts.2ti.1.5: gardant le souvenir de la foi sincère qui est en toi, qui habita d'abord dans ton aïeule Loïs et dans ta mère Eunice, et qui, j'en suis persuadé, habite aussi en toi.
texts.2ti.1.6: C'est pourquoi je t'exhorte à ranimer le don de Dieu que tu as reçu par l'imposition de mes mains.
texts.2ti.1.7: Car ce n'est pas un esprit de timidité que Dieu nous a donné, mais un esprit de force, d'amour et de sagesse.
texts.2ti.1.8: N'aie donc point honte du témoignage à rendre à notre Seigneur, ni de moi son prisonnier. Mais souffre avec moi pour l'Evangile, par la puissance de Dieu
texts.2ti.1.9: qui nous a sauvés, et nous a adressé une sainte vocation, non à cause de nos oeuvres, mais selon son propre dessein, et selon la grâce qui nous a été donnée en Jésus-Christ avant les temps éternels,
texts.2ti.1.10: et qui a été manifestée maintenant par l'apparition de notre Sauveur Jésus-Christ, qui a détruit la mort et a mis en évidence la vie et l'immortalité par l'Evangile.
texts.2ti.1.11: C'est pour cet Evangile que j'ai été établi prédicateur et apôtre, chargé d'instruire les païens.
texts.2ti.1.12: Et c'est à cause de cela que je souffre ces choses; mais j'en ai point honte, car je sais en qui j'ai cru, et je suis persuadé qu'il a la puissance de garder mon dépôt jusqu'à ce jour-là.
texts.2ti.1.13: Retiens dans la foi et dans la charité qui est en Jésus-Christ le modèle des saines paroles que tu as reçues de moi.
texts.2ti.1.14: Garde le bon dépôt, par le Saint-Esprit qui habite en nous.
texts.2ti.1.15: Tu sais que tous ceux qui sont en Asie m'ont abandonné, entre autres Phygelle et Hermogène.
texts.2ti.1.16: Que le Seigneur répande sa miséricorde sur la maison d'Onésiphore, car il m'a souvent consolé, et il n'a pas eu honte de mes chaînes;
texts.2ti.1.17: au contraire, lorsqu'il est venu à Rome, il m'a cherché avec beaucoup d'empressement, et il m'a trouvé.
texts.2ti.1.18: Que le Seigneur lui donne d'obtenir miséricorde auprès du Seigneur en ce jour-là. Tu sais mieux que personne combien de services il m'a rendus à Ephèse.
texts.2ti.2.1: Toi donc, mon enfant, fortifie-toi dans la grâce qui est en Jésus-Christ.
texts.2ti.2.2: Et ce que tu as entendu de moi en présence de beaucoup de témoins, confie-le à des hommes fidèles, qui soient capables de l'enseigner aussi à d'autres.
texts.2ti.2.3: Souffre avec moi, comme un bon soldat de Jésus-Christ.
texts.2ti.2.4: Il n'est pas de soldat qui s'embarrasse des affaires de la vie, s'il veut plaire à celui qui l'a enrôlé;
texts.2ti.2.5: et l'athlète n'est pas couronné, s'il n'a combattu suivant les règles.
texts.2ti.2.6: Il faut que le laboureur travaille avant de recueillir les fruits.
texts.2ti.2.7: Comprends ce que je dis, car le Seigneur te donnera de l'intelligence en toutes choses.
texts.2ti.2.8: Souviens-toi de Jésus-Christ, issu de la postérité de David, ressuscité des morts, selon mon Evangile,
texts.2ti.2.9: pour lequel je souffre jusqu'à être lié comme un malfaiteur. Mais la parole de Dieu n'est pas liée.
texts.2ti.2.10: C'est pourquoi je supporte tout à cause des élus, afin qu'eux aussi obtiennent le salut qui est en Jésus-Christ, avec la gloire éternelle.
texts.2ti.2.11: Cette parole est certaine: Si nous sommes morts avec lui, nous vivrons aussi avec lui;
texts.2ti.2.12: si nous persévérons, nous régnerons aussi avec lui; si nous le renions, lui aussi nous reniera;
texts.2ti.2.13: si nous sommes infidèles, il demeure fidèle, car il ne peut se renier lui-même.
texts.2ti.2.14: Rappelle ces choses, en conjurant devant Dieu qu'on évite les disputes de mots, qui ne servent qu'à la ruine de ceux qui écoutent.
texts.2ti.2.15: Efforce-toi de te présenter devant Dieu comme un homme éprouvé, un ouvrier qui n'a point à rougir, qui dispense droitement la parole de la vérité.
texts.2ti.2.16: Evite les discours vains et profanes; car ceux qui les tiennent avanceront toujours plus dans l'impiété,
texts.2ti.2.17: et leur parole rongera comme la gangrène. De ce nombre sont Hyménée et Philète,
texts.2ti.2.18: qui se sont détournés de la vérité, disant que la résurrection est déjà arrivée, et qui renversent la foi de quelques uns.
texts.2ti.2.19: Néanmoins, le solide fondement de Dieu reste debout, avec ces paroles qui lui servent de sceau: Le Seigneur connaît ceux qui lui appartiennent; et: Quiconque prononce le nom du Seigneur, qu'il s'éloigne de l'iniquité.
texts.2ti.2.20: Dans une grande maison, il n'y a pas seulement des vases d'or et d'argent, mais il y en a aussi de bois et de terre; les uns sont des vases d'honneur, et les autres sont d'un usage vil.
texts.2ti.2.21: Si donc quelqu'un se conserve pur, en s'abstenant de ces choses, il sera un vase d'honneur, sanctifié, utile à son maître, propre à toute bonne oeuvre.
texts.2ti.2.22: Fuis les passions de la jeunesse, et recherche la justice, la foi, la charité, la paix, avec ceux qui invoquent le Seigneur d'un coeur pur.
texts.2ti.2.23: Repousse les discussions folles et inutiles, sachant qu'elles font naître des querelles.
texts.2ti.2.24: Or, il ne faut pas qu'un serviteur du Seigneur ait des querelles; il doit, au contraire, avoir de la condescendance pour tous, être propre à enseigner, doué de patience;
texts.2ti.2.25: il doit redresser avec douceur les adversaires, dans l'espérance que Dieu leur donnera la repentance pour arriver à la connaissance de la vérité,
texts.2ti.2.26: et que, revenus à leur bon sens, ils se dégageront des pièges du diable, qui s'est emparé d'eux pour les soumettre à sa volonté.
texts.2ti.3.1: Sache que, dans les derniers jours, il y aura des temps difficiles.
texts.2ti.3.2: Car les hommes seront égoïstes, amis de l'argent, fanfarons, hautains, blasphémateurs, rebelles à leurs parents, ingrats, irréligieux,
texts.2ti.3.3: insensibles, déloyaux, calomniateurs, intempérants, cruels, ennemis des gens de bien,
texts.2ti.3.4: traîtres, emportés, enflés d'orgueil, aimant le plaisir plus que Dieu,
texts.2ti.3.5: ayant l'apparence de la piété, mais reniant ce qui en fait la force. Eloigne-toi de ces hommes-là.
texts.2ti.3.6: Il en est parmi eux qui s'introduisent dans les maisons, et qui captivent des femmes d'un esprit faible et borné, chargées de péchés, agitées par des passions de toute espèce,
texts.2ti.3.7: apprenant toujours et ne pouvant jamais arriver à la connaissance de la vérité.
texts.2ti.3.8: De même que Jannès et Jambrès s'opposèrent à Moïse, de même ces hommes s'opposent à la vérité, étant corrompus d'entendement, réprouvés en ce qui concerne la foi.
texts.2ti.3.9: Mais ils ne feront pas de plus grands progrès; car leur folie sera manifeste pour tous, comme le fut celle de ces deux hommes.
texts.2ti.3.10: Pour toi, tu as suivi de près mon enseignement, ma conduite, mes résolutions, ma foi, ma douceur, ma charité, ma constance,
texts.2ti.3.11: mes persécutions, mes souffrances. A quelles souffrances n'ai-je pas été exposé à Antioche, à Icone, à Lystre? Quelles persécutions n'ai-je pas supportées? Et le Seigneur m'a délivré de toutes.
texts.2ti.3.12: Or, tous ceux qui veulent vivre pieusement en Jésus-Christ seront persécutés.
texts.2ti.3.13: Mais les hommes méchants et imposteurs avanceront toujours plus dans le mal, égarant les autres et égarés eux-mêmes.
texts.2ti.3.14: Toi, demeure dans les choses que tu as apprises, et reconnues certaines, sachant de qui tu les as apprises;
texts.2ti.3.15: dès ton enfance, tu connais les saintes lettres, qui peuvent te rendre sage à salut par la foi en Jésus-Christ.
texts.2ti.3.16: Toute Ecriture est inspirée de Dieu, et utile pour enseigner, pour convaincre, pour corriger, pour instruire dans la justice,
texts.2ti.3.17: afin que l'homme de Dieu soit accompli et propre à toute bonne oeuvre.
texts.2ti.4.1: Je t'en conjure devant Dieu et devant Jésus-Christ, qui doit juger les vivants et les morts, et au nom de son apparition et de son royaume,
texts.2ti.4.2: prêche la parole, insiste en toute occasion, favorable ou non, reprends, censure, exhorte, avec toute douceur et en instruisant.
texts.2ti.4.3: Car il viendra un temps où les hommes ne supporteront pas la saine doctrine; mais, ayant la démangeaison d'entendre des choses agréables, ils se donneront une foule de docteurs selon leurs propres désirs,
texts.2ti.4.4: détourneront l'oreille de la vérité, et se tourneront vers les fables.
texts.2ti.4.5: Mais toi, sois sobre en toutes choses, supporte les souffrances, fais l'oeuvre d'un évangéliste, remplis bien ton ministère.
texts.2ti.4.6: Car pour moi, je sers déjà de libation, et le moment de mon départ approche.
texts.2ti.4.7: J'ai combattu le bon combat, j'ai achevé la course, j'ai gardé la foi.
texts.2ti.4.8: Désormais la couronne de justice m'est réservée; le Seigneur, le juste juge, me la donnera dans ce jour-là, et non seulement à moi, mais encore à tous ceux qui auront aimé son avènement.
texts.2ti.4.9: Viens au plus tôt vers moi;
texts.2ti.4.10: car Démas m'a abandonné, par amour pour le siècle présent, et il est parti pour Thessalonique; Crescens est allé en Galatie, Tite en Dalmatie.
texts.2ti.4.11: Luc seul est avec moi. Prends Marc, et amène-le avec toi, car il m'est utile pour le ministère.
texts.2ti.4.13: Quand tu viendras, apporte le manteau que j'ai laissé à Troas chez Carpus, et les livres, surtout les parchemins.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alexandre, le forgeron, m'a fait beaucoup de mal. Le Seigneur lui rendra selon ses oeuvres.
texts.2ti.4.15: Garde-toi aussi de lui, car il s'est fortement opposé à nos paroles.
texts.2ti.4.16: Dans ma première défense, personne ne m'a assisté, mais tous m'ont abandonné. Que cela ne leur soit point imputé!
texts.2ti.4.17: C'est le Seigneur qui m'a assisté et qui m'a fortifié, afin que la prédication fût accomplie par moi et que tous les païens l'entendissent. Et j'ai été délivré de la gueule du lion.
texts.2ti.4.18: Le Seigneur me délivrera de toute oeuvre mauvaise, et il me sauvera pour me faire entrer dans son royaume céleste. A lui soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
texts.2ti.4.19: Salue Prisca et Aquilas, et la famille d'Onésiphore.
texts.2ti.4.20: Eraste est resté à Corinthe, et j'ai laissé Trophime malade à Milet.
texts.2ti.4.21: Tâche de venir avant l'hiver. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, et tous les frères te saluent.
texts.2ti.4.22: Que le Seigneur soit avec ton esprit! Que la grâce soit avec vous!

texts.2ti.1.1: Paulus, ein Apostel Jesu Christi durch den Willen Gottes nach der Verheißung des Lebens in Christo Jesu,
texts.2ti.1.2: meinem lieben Sohn Timotheus: Gnade, Barmherzigkeit, Friede von Gott, dem Vater, und Christo Jesu, unserm HERRN!
texts.2ti.1.3: Ich danke Gott, dem ich diene von meinen Voreltern her in reinem Gewissen, daß ich ohne Unterlaß dein gedenke in meinem Gebet Tag und Nacht;
texts.2ti.1.4: und mich verlangt, dich zu sehen, wenn ich denke an deine Tränen, auf daß ich mit Freude erfüllt würde;
texts.2ti.1.5: und wenn ich mich erinnere des ungefärbten Glaubens in dir, welcher zuvor gewohnt hat in deiner Großmutter Lois und deiner Mutter Eunike; ich bin aber gewiß, auch in dir.
texts.2ti.1.6: Um solcher Ursache willen erinnere ich dich, daß du erweckest die Gabe Gottes, die in dir ist durch die Auflegung meiner Hände.
texts.2ti.1.7: Denn Gott hat uns nicht gegeben den Geist der Furcht, sondern der Kraft und der Liebe und der Zucht.
texts.2ti.1.8: Darum so schäme dich nicht des Zeugnisses unsers HERRN noch meiner, der ich sein Gebundener bin, sondern leide mit für das Evangelium wie ich, nach der Kraft Gottes,
texts.2ti.1.9: der uns hat selig gemacht und berufen mit einem heiligen Ruf, nicht nach unsern Werken, sondern nach dem Vorsatz und der Gnade, die uns gegeben ist in Christo Jesu vor der Zeit der Welt,
texts.2ti.1.10: jetzt aber offenbart durch die Erscheinung unsers Heilandes Jesu Christi, der dem Tode die Macht hat genommen und das Leben und ein unvergänglich Wesen ans Licht gebracht durch das Evangelium,
texts.2ti.1.11: für welches ich gesetzt bin als Prediger und Apostel der Heiden.
texts.2ti.1.12: Um dieser Ursache willen leide ich auch solches; aber ich schäme mich dessen nicht; denn ich weiß, an wen ich glaube, und bin gewiß, er kann mir bewahren, was mir beigelegt ist, bis an jenen Tag.
texts.2ti.1.13: Halte an dem Vorbilde der heilsamen Worte, die du von mir gehört hast, im Glauben und in der Liebe in Christo Jesu.
texts.2ti.1.14: Dies beigelegte Gut bewahre durch den heiligen Geist, der in uns wohnt.
texts.2ti.1.15: Das weißt du, daß sich von mir gewandt haben alle, die in Asien sind, unter welchen ist Phygellus und Hermogenes.
texts.2ti.1.16: Der HERR gebe Barmherzigkeit dem Hause Onesiphorus; denn er hat mich oft erquickt und hat sich meiner Kette nicht geschämt,
texts.2ti.1.17: sondern da er zu Rom war, suchte er mich aufs fleißigste und fand mich.
texts.2ti.1.18: Der HERR gebe ihm, daß er finde Barmherzigkeit bei dem HERRN an jenem Tage. Und wieviel er zu Ephesus gedient hat, weißt du am besten.
texts.2ti.2.1: So sei nun stark, mein Sohn, durch die Gnade in Christo Jesu.
texts.2ti.2.2: Und was du von mir gehört hast durch viele Zeugen, das befiehl treuen Menschen, die da tüchtig sind, auch andere zu lehren.
texts.2ti.2.3: Leide mit als ein guter Streiter Jesu Christi.
texts.2ti.2.4: Kein Kriegsmann flicht sich in Händel der Nahrung, auf daß er gefalle dem, der ihn angenommen hat.
texts.2ti.2.5: Und so jemand auch kämpft, wird er doch nicht gekrönt, er kämpfe denn recht.
texts.2ti.2.6: Es soll aber der Ackermann, der den Acker baut, die Früchte am ersten genießen. Merke, was ich sage!
texts.2ti.2.7: Der HERR aber wird dir in allen Dingen Verstand geben.
texts.2ti.2.8: Halt im Gedächtnis Jesum Christum, der auferstanden ist von den Toten, aus dem Samen Davids, nach meinem Evangelium,
texts.2ti.2.9: für welches ich leide bis zu den Banden wie ein Übeltäter; aber Gottes Wort ist nicht gebunden.
texts.2ti.2.10: Darum erdulde ich alles um der Auserwählten willen, auf daß auch sie die Seligkeit erlangen in Christo Jesu mit ewiger Herrlichkeit.
texts.2ti.2.11: Das ist gewißlich wahr: Sterben wir mit, so werden wir mitleben;
texts.2ti.2.12: dulden wir, so werden wir mitherrschen; verleugnen wir, so wird er uns auch verleugnen;
texts.2ti.2.13: glauben wir nicht, so bleibt er treu; er kann sich selbst nicht verleugnen.
texts.2ti.2.14: Solches erinnere sie und bezeuge vor dem HERRN, daß sie nicht um Worte zanken, welches nichts nütze ist denn zu verkehren, die da zuhören.
texts.2ti.2.15: Befleißige dich, Gott dich zu erzeigen als einen rechtschaffenen und unsträflichen Arbeiter, der da recht teile das Wort der Wahrheit.
texts.2ti.2.16: Des ungeistlichen, losen Geschwätzes entschlage dich; denn es hilft viel zum ungöttlichen Wesen,
texts.2ti.2.17: und ihr Wort frißt um sich wie der Krebs; unter welchen ist Hymenäus und Philetus,
texts.2ti.2.18: welche von der Wahrheit irregegangen sind und sagen, die Auferstehung sei schon geschehen, und haben etlicher Glauben verkehrt.
texts.2ti.2.19: Aber der feste Grund Gottes besteht und hat dieses Siegel: Der HERR kennt die seinen; und: Es trete ab von Ungerechtigkeit, wer den Namen Christi nennt.
texts.2ti.2.20: In einem großen Hause aber sind nicht allein goldene und silberne Gefäße, sondern auch hölzerne und irdene, und etliche zu Ehren, etliche aber zu Unehren.
texts.2ti.2.21: So nun jemand sich reinigt von solchen Leuten, der wird ein geheiligtes Gefäß sein zu Ehren, dem Hausherrn bräuchlich und zu allem guten Werk bereitet.
texts.2ti.2.22: Fliehe die Lüste der Jugend; jage aber nach der Gerechtigkeit, dem Glauben, der Liebe, dem Frieden mit allen, die den HERRN anrufen von reinem Herzen.
texts.2ti.2.23: Aber der törichten und unnützen Fragen entschlage dich; denn du weißt, daß sie nur Zank gebären.
texts.2ti.2.24: Ein Knecht aber des HERRN soll nicht zänkisch sein, sondern freundlich gegen jedermann, lehrhaft, der die Bösen tragen kann
texts.2ti.2.25: und mit Sanftmut strafe die Widerspenstigen, ob ihnen Gott dermaleinst Buße gebe, die Wahrheit zu erkennen,
texts.2ti.2.26: und sie wieder nüchtern würden aus des Teufels Strick, von dem sie gefangen sind zu seinem Willen.
texts.2ti.3.1: Das sollst du aber wissen, daß in den letzten Tagen werden greuliche Zeiten kommen.
texts.2ti.3.2: Denn es werden Menschen sein, die viel von sich halten, geizig, ruhmredig, hoffärtig, Lästerer, den Eltern ungehorsam, undankbar, ungeistlich,
texts.2ti.3.3: lieblos, unversöhnlich, Verleumder, unkeusch, wild, ungütig,
texts.2ti.3.4: Verräter, Frevler, aufgeblasen, die mehr lieben Wollust denn Gott,
texts.2ti.3.5: die da haben den Schein eines gottseligen Wesens, aber seine Kraft verleugnen sie; und solche meide.
texts.2ti.3.6: Aus denselben sind, die hin und her in die Häuser schleichen und führen die Weiblein gefangen, die mit Sünden beladen sind und von mancherlei Lüsten umgetrieben,
texts.2ti.3.7: lernen immerdar, und können nimmer zur Erkenntnis kommen.
texts.2ti.3.8: Gleicherweise aber, wie Jannes und Jambres dem Mose widerstanden, also widerstehen auch diese der Wahrheit; es sind Menschen von zerrütteten Sinnen, untüchtig zum Glauben.
texts.2ti.3.9: Aber sie werden's in die Länge nicht treiben; denn ihre Torheit wird offenbar werden jedermann, gleichwie auch jener Torheit offenbar ward.
texts.2ti.3.10: Du aber bist nachgefolgt meiner Lehre, meiner Weise, meiner Meinung, meinem Glauben, meiner Langmut, meiner Liebe, meiner Geduld,
texts.2ti.3.11: meinen Verfolgungen, meinen Leiden, welche mir widerfahren sind zu Antiochien, zu Ikonien, zu Lystra. Welche Verfolgungen ich da ertrug! Und aus allen hat mich der HERR erlöst.
texts.2ti.3.12: Und alle, die gottselig leben wollen in Christo Jesu, müssen Verfolgung leiden.
texts.2ti.3.13: Mit den bösen Menschen aber und verführerischen wird's je länger, je ärger: sie verführen und werden verführt.
texts.2ti.3.14: Du aber bleibe in dem, was du gelernt hast und dir vertrauet ist, sintemal du weißt, von wem du gelernt hast.
texts.2ti.3.15: Und weil du von Kind auf die heilige Schrift weißt, kann dich dieselbe unterweisen zur Seligkeit durch den Glauben an Christum Jesum.
texts.2ti.3.16: Denn alle Schrift, von Gott eingegeben, ist nütze zur Lehre, zur Strafe, zur Besserung, zur Züchtigung in der Gerechtigkeit,
texts.2ti.3.17: daß ein Mensch Gottes sei vollkommen, zu allem guten Werk geschickt.
texts.2ti.4.1: So bezeuge ich nun vor Gott und dem HERRN Jesus Christus, der da zukünftig ist, zu richten die Lebendigen und die Toten mit seiner Erscheinung und mit seinem Reich:
texts.2ti.4.2: Predige das Wort, halte an, es sei zu rechter Zeit oder zur Unzeit; strafe, drohe, ermahne mit aller Geduld und Lehre.
texts.2ti.4.3: Denn es wird eine Zeit sein, da sie die heilsame Lehre nicht leiden werden; sondern nach ihren eigenen Lüsten werden sie sich selbst Lehrer aufladen, nach dem ihnen die Ohren jucken,
texts.2ti.4.4: und werden die Ohren von der Wahrheit wenden und sich zu Fabeln kehren.
texts.2ti.4.5: Du aber sei nüchtern allenthalben, sei willig, zu leiden, tue das Werk eines evangelischen Predigers, richte dein Amt redlich aus.
texts.2ti.4.6: Denn ich werde schon geopfert, und die Zeit meines Abscheidens ist vorhanden.
texts.2ti.4.7: Ich habe einen guten Kampf gekämpft, ich habe den Lauf vollendet, ich habe Glauben gehalten;
texts.2ti.4.8: hinfort ist mir beigelegt die Krone der Gerechtigkeit, welche mir der HERR an jenem Tage, der gerechte Richter, geben wird, nicht aber mir allein, sondern auch allen, die seine Erscheinung liebhaben.
texts.2ti.4.9: Befleißige dich, daß du bald zu mir kommst.
texts.2ti.4.10: Denn Demas hat mich verlassen und hat diese Welt liebgewonnen und ist gen Thessalonich gezogen, Kreszens nach Galatien, Titus nach Dalmatien.
texts.2ti.4.11: Lukas allein ist bei mir. Markus nimm zu dir und bringe ihn mit dir; denn er ist mir nützlich zum Dienst.
texts.2ti.4.12: Tychikus habe ich gen Ephesus gesandt.
texts.2ti.4.13: Den Mantel, den ich zu Troas ließ bei Karpus, bringe mit, wenn du kommst, und die Bücher, sonderlich die Pergamente.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alexander, der Schmied, hat mir viel Böses bewiesen; der HERR bezahle ihm nach seinen Werken.
texts.2ti.4.15: Vor dem hüte du dich auch; denn er hat unsern Worten sehr widerstanden.
texts.2ti.4.16: In meiner ersten Verantwortung stand mir niemand bei, sondern sie verließen mich alle. Es sei ihnen nicht zugerechnet.
texts.2ti.4.17: Der HERR aber stand mir bei und stärkte mich, auf daß durch mich die Predigt bestätigt würde und alle Heiden sie hörten; und ich ward erlöst von des Löwen Rachen.
texts.2ti.4.18: Der HERR aber wird mich erlösen von allem Übel und mir aushelfen zu seinem himmlischen Reich; welchem sei Ehre von Ewigkeit zu Ewigkeit! Amen.
texts.2ti.4.19: Grüße Priska und Aquila und das Haus des Onesiphorus.
texts.2ti.4.20: Erastus blieb zu Korinth; Trophimus aber ließ ich zu Milet krank.
texts.2ti.4.21: Tue Fleiß, daß du vor dem Winter kommst. Es grüßt dich Eubulus und Pudens und Linus und Klaudia und alle Brüder.
texts.2ti.4.22: Der HERR Jesus Christus sei mit deinem Geiste! Die Gnade sei mit euch! Amen.

texts.2ti.1.1: Павел, волею Божиею Апостол Иисуса Христа, по обетованию жизни во Христе Иисусе,
texts.2ti.1.2: Тимофею, возлюбленному сыну: благодать, милость, мир от Бога Отца и Христа Иисуса, Господа нашего.
texts.2ti.1.3: Благодарю Бога, Которому служу от прародителей с чистою совестью, что непрестанно вспоминаю о тебе в молитвах моих днем и ночью,
texts.2ti.1.4: и желаю видеть тебя, вспоминая о слезах твоих, дабы мне исполниться радости,
texts.2ti.1.5: приводя на память нелицемерную веру твою, которая прежде обитала в бабке твоей Лоиде и матери твоей Евнике; уверен, что она и в тебе.
texts.2ti.1.6: По сей причине напоминаю тебе возгревать дар Божий, который в тебе через мое рукоположение;
texts.2ti.1.7: ибо дал нам Бог духа не боязни, но силы и любви и целомудрия.
texts.2ti.1.8: Итак, не стыдись свидетельства Господа нашего Иисуса Христа, ни меня, узника Его; но страдай с благовестием Христовым силою Бога,
texts.2ti.1.9: спасшего нас и призвавшего званием святым, не по делам нашим, но по Своему изволению и благодати, данной нам во Христе Иисусе прежде вековых времен,
texts.2ti.1.10: открывшейся же ныне явлением Спасителя нашего Иисуса Христа, разрушившего смерть и явившего жизнь и нетление через благовестие,
texts.2ti.1.11: для которого я поставлен проповедником и Апостолом и учителем язычников.
texts.2ti.1.12: По сей причине я и страдаю так; но не стыжусь. Ибо я знаю, в Кого уверовал, и уверен, что Он силен сохранить залог мой на оный день.
texts.2ti.1.13: Держись образца здравого учения, которое ты слышал от меня, с верою и любовью во Христе Иисусе.
texts.2ti.1.14: Храни добрый залог Духом Святым, живущим в нас.
texts.2ti.1.15: Ты знаешь, что все Асийские оставили меня; в числе их Фигелл и Ермоген.
texts.2ti.1.16: Да даст Господь милость дому Онисифора за то, что он многократно покоил меня и не стыдился уз моих,
texts.2ti.1.17: но, быв в Риме, с великим тщанием искал меня и нашел.
texts.2ti.1.18: Да даст ему Господь обрести милость у Господа в оный день; а сколько он служил мне в Ефесе, ты лучше знаешь.
texts.2ti.2.1: Итак укрепляйся, сын мой, в благодати Христом Иисусом,
texts.2ti.2.2: и что слышал от меня при многих свидетелях, то передай верным людям, которые были бы способны и других научить.
texts.2ti.2.3: Итак переноси страдания, как добрый воин Иисуса Христа.
texts.2ti.2.4: Никакой воин не связывает себя делами житейскими, чтобы угодить военачальнику.
texts.2ti.2.5: Если же кто и подвизается, не увенчивается, если незаконно будет подвизаться.
texts.2ti.2.6: Трудящемуся земледельцу первому должно вкусить от плодов.
texts.2ti.2.7: Разумей, что я говорю. Да даст тебе Господь разумение во всем.
texts.2ti.2.8: Помни Господа Иисуса Христа от семени Давидова, воскресшего из мертвых, по благовествованию моему,
texts.2ti.2.9: за которое я страдаю даже до уз, как злодей; но для слова Божия нет уз.
texts.2ti.2.10: Посему я все терплю ради избранных, дабы и они получили спасение во Христе Иисусе с вечною славою.
texts.2ti.2.11: Верно слово: если мы с Ним умерли, то с Ним и оживем;
texts.2ti.2.12: если терпим, то с Ним и царствовать будем; если отречемся, и Он отречется от нас;
texts.2ti.2.13: если мы неверны, Он пребывает верен, ибо Себя отречься не может.
texts.2ti.2.14: Сие напоминай, заклиная пред Господом не вступать в словопрения, что нимало не служит к пользе, а к расстройству слушающих.
texts.2ti.2.15: Старайся представить себя Богу достойным, делателем неукоризненным, верно преподающим слово истины.
texts.2ti.2.16: А непотребного пустословия удаляйся; ибо они еще более будут преуспевать в нечестии,
texts.2ti.2.17: и слово их, как рак, будет распространяться. Таковы Именей и Филит,
texts.2ti.2.18: которые отступили от истины, говоря, что воскресение уже было, и разрушают в некоторых веру.
texts.2ti.2.19: Но твердое основание Божие стоит, имея печать сию: "познал Господь Своих"; и: "да отступит от неправды всякий, исповедующий имя Господа".
texts.2ti.2.20: А в большом доме есть сосуды не только золотые и серебряные, но и деревянные и глиняные; и одни в почетном, а другие в низком употреблении.
texts.2ti.2.21: Итак, кто будет чист от сего, тот будет сосудом в чести, освященным и благопотребным Владыке, годным на всякое доброе дело.
texts.2ti.2.22: Юношеских похотей убегай, а держись правды, веры, любви, мира со всеми призывающими Господа от чистого сердца.
texts.2ti.2.23: От глупых и невежественных состязаний уклоняйся, зная, что они рождают ссоры;
texts.2ti.2.24: рабу же Господа не должно ссориться, но быть приветливым ко всем, учительным, незлобивым,
texts.2ti.2.25: с кротостью наставлять противников, не даст ли им Бог покаяния к познанию истины,
texts.2ti.2.26: чтобы они освободились от сети диавола, который уловил их в свою волю.
texts.2ti.3.1: Знай же, что в последние дни наступят времена тяжкие.
texts.2ti.3.2: Ибо люди будут самолюбивы, сребролюбивы, горды, надменны, злоречивы, родителям непокорны, неблагодарны, нечестивы, недружелюбны,
texts.2ti.3.3: непримирительны, клеветники, невоздержны, жестоки, не любящие добра,
texts.2ti.3.4: предатели, наглы, напыщенны, более сластолюбивы, нежели боголюбивы,
texts.2ti.3.5: имеющие вид благочестия, силы же его отрекшиеся. Таковых удаляйся.
texts.2ti.3.6: К сим принадлежат те, которые вкрадываются в домы и обольщают женщин, утопающих во грехах, водимых различными похотями,
texts.2ti.3.7: всегда учащихся и никогда не могущих дойти до познания истины.
texts.2ti.3.8: Как Ианний и Иамврий противились Моисею, так и сии противятся истине, люди, развращенные умом, невежды в вере.
texts.2ti.3.9: Но они не много успеют; ибо их безумие обнаружится перед всеми, как и с теми случилось.
texts.2ti.3.10: А ты последовал мне в учении, житии, расположении, вере, великодушии, любви, терпении,
texts.2ti.3.11: в гонениях, страданиях, постигших меня в Антиохии, Иконии, Листрах; каковые гонения я перенес, и от всех избавил меня Господь.
texts.2ti.3.12: Да и все, желающие жить благочестиво во Христе Иисусе, будут гонимы.
texts.2ti.3.13: Злые же люди и обманщики будут преуспевать во зле, вводя в заблуждение и заблуждаясь.
texts.2ti.3.14: А ты пребывай в том, чему научен и что тебе вверено, зная, кем ты научен.
texts.2ti.3.15: Притом же ты из детства знаешь священные писания, которые могут умудрить тебя во спасение верою во Христа Иисуса.
texts.2ti.3.16: Все Писание богодухновенно и полезно для научения, для обличения, для исправления, для наставления в праведности,
texts.2ti.3.17: да будет совершен Божий человек, ко всякому доброму делу приготовлен.
texts.2ti.4.1: Итак заклинаю тебя пред Богом и Господом нашим Иисусом Христом, Который будет судить живых и мертвых в явление Его и Царствие Его:
texts.2ti.4.2: проповедуй слово, настой во время и не во время, обличай, запрещай, увещевай со всяким долготерпением и назиданием.
texts.2ti.4.3: Ибо будет время, когда здравого учения принимать не будут, но по своим прихотям будут избирать себе учителей, которые льстили бы слуху;
texts.2ti.4.4: и от истины отвратят слух и обратятся к басням.
texts.2ti.4.5: Но ты будь бдителен во всем, переноси скорби, совершай дело благовестника, исполняй служение твое.
texts.2ti.4.6: Ибо я уже становлюсь жертвою, и время моего отшествия настало.
texts.2ti.4.7: Подвигом добрым я подвизался, течение совершил, веру сохранил;
texts.2ti.4.8: а теперь готовится мне венец правды, который даст мне Господь, праведный Судия, в день оный; и не только мне, но и всем, возлюбившим явление Его.
texts.2ti.4.10: Ибо Димас оставил меня, возлюбив нынешний век, и пошел в Фессалонику, Крискент в Галатию, Тит в Далматию; один Лука со мною.
texts.2ti.4.11: Марка возьми и приведи с собою, ибо он мне нужен для служения.
texts.2ti.4.13: Когда пойдешь, принеси фелонь, который я оставил в Троаде у Карпа, и книги, особенно кожаные.
texts.2ti.4.14: Александр медник много сделал мне зла. Да воздаст ему Господь по делам его!
texts.2ti.4.15: Берегись его и ты, ибо он сильно противился нашим словам.
texts.2ti.4.16: При первом моем ответе никого не было со мною, но все меня оставили. Да не вменится им!
texts.2ti.4.17: Господь же предстал мне и укрепил меня, дабы через меня утвердилось благовестие и услышали все язычники; и я избавился из львиных челюстей.
texts.2ti.4.18: И избавит меня Господь от всякого злого дела и сохранит для Своего Небесного Царства, Ему слава во веки веков. Аминь.
texts.2ti.4.19: Приветствуй Прискиллу и Акилу и дом Онисифоров.
texts.2ti.4.20: Ераст остался в Коринфе; Трофима же я оставил больного в Милите.
texts.2ti.4.21: Постарайся придти до зимы. Приветствуют тебя Еввул, и Пуд, и Лин, и Клавдия, и все братия.
texts.2ti.4.22: Господь Иисус Христос со духом твоим. Благодать с вами. Аминь.

texts.2ti.1.1: Paulo, apostolo de Jesus Christo, pela vontade de Deus, segundo a promessa da vida que está em Christo Jesus,
texts.2ti.1.2: A Timotheo, meu amado filho: graça, misericordia, e paz da parte de Deus Pae, e da de Christo Jesus Senhor nosso.
texts.2ti.1.3: Dou graças a Deus, a quem desde os meus antepassados sirvo com uma consciencia pura, de que sem cessar faço memoria de ti nas minhas orações noite e dia;
texts.2ti.1.4: Desejando muito vêr-te, lembrando-me de tuas lagrimas, para me encher de gozo:
texts.2ti.1.5: Trazendo á memoria a fé não fingida que em ti ha, a qual habitou primeiro em tua avó Loide, e em tua mãe Eunice, e estou certo de que tambem habita em ti.
texts.2ti.1.6: Por cujo motivo te lembro que despertes o dom de Deus que existe em ti pela imposição das minhas mãos.
texts.2ti.1.7: Porque Deus não nos deu o espirito de temor, mas de fortaleza, e de amor, e de moderação.
texts.2ti.1.8: Portanto não te envergonhes do testemunho de nosso Senhor, nem de mim, que sou prisioneiro seu; antes participa das afflicções do evangelho segundo o poder de Deus,
texts.2ti.1.9: O qual nos salvou, e chamou com uma sancta vocação; não segundo as nossas obras, mas segundo o seu proprio proposito e graça que nos foi dada em Christo Jesus antes dos tempos dos seculos;
texts.2ti.1.10: Mas agora é manifesta pela apparição de nosso Salvador Jesus Christo, o qual aboliu a morte, e trouxe á luz a vida e a incorrupção pelo evangelho;
texts.2ti.1.11: Para o que fui constituido prégador, e apostolo, e doutor dos gentios.
texts.2ti.1.12: Por cuja causa padeço tambem estas coisas, porém não me envergonho; porque eu sei em quem tenho crido, e estou certo de que é poderoso para guardar o meu deposito até áquelle dia.
texts.2ti.1.13: Conserva o exemplar das sãs palavras que de mim tens ouvido, na fé e na caridade que ha em Christo Jesus.
texts.2ti.1.14: Guarda o bom deposito pelo Espirito Sancto que habita em nós.
texts.2ti.1.15: Bem sabes isto, que os que estão na Asia todos se apartaram de mim; entre os quaes foram Phygelo e Hermogenes.
texts.2ti.1.16: O Senhor faça misericordia á casa de Onesiphoro, porque muitas vezes me recreou, e não se envergonhou das minhas cadeias.
texts.2ti.1.17: Antes, vindo elle a Roma, com muito cuidado me procurou e me achou.
texts.2ti.1.18: O Senhor lhe conceda que n’aquelle dia ache misericordia diante do Senhor. E, quanto me ajudou em Epheso, melhor o sabes tu.
texts.2ti.2.1: Tu, pois, meu filho, fortifica-te na graça que ha em Christo Jesus.
texts.2ti.2.2: E o que de mim, d’entre muitas testemunhas, ouviste, confia-o a homens fieis, que sejam idoneos para tambem ensinarem os outros.
texts.2ti.2.3: Tu, pois, soffre as afflicções como bom soldado de Jesus Christo.
texts.2ti.2.4: Ninguem que milita se embaraça com negocios d’esta vida, para agradar áquelle que o alistou para a guerra.
texts.2ti.2.5: E, se alguem tambem milita, não é coroado se não militar legitimamente.
texts.2ti.2.6: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a gozar dos fructos.
texts.2ti.2.7: Considera o que digo: o Senhor, porém, te dê entendimento em tudo.
texts.2ti.2.8: Lembra-te de que Jesus Christo, que é da descendencia de David, resuscitou dos mortos, segundo o meu evangelho;
texts.2ti.2.9: Pelo que soffro trabalhos e até prisões, como um malfeitor; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.
texts.2ti.2.10: Portanto tudo soffro por amor dos escolhidos, para que tambem elles alcancem a salvação que está em Christo Jesus com gloria eterna.
texts.2ti.2.11: Palavra fiel é esta: que, se morrermos com elle, tambem com elle viveremos:
texts.2ti.2.12: Se soffrermos, tambem com elle reinaremos: se o negarmos, tambem elle nos negará:
texts.2ti.2.13: Se formos infiéis, elle permanece fiel: não pode negar-se a si mesmo.
texts.2ti.2.14: Traze estas coisas á memoria, protestando diante do Senhor que não tenham contendas de palavras, que para nada aproveitam senão para perversão dos ouvintes.
texts.2ti.2.15: Procura apresentar-te a Deus approvado, como obreiro que não tem de que se envergonhar, que maneja bem a palavra da verdade.
texts.2ti.2.16: Mas oppõe-te aos clamores vãos e profanos, porque produzirão maior impiedade.
texts.2ti.2.17: E a sua palavra roerá como cancro; entre os quaes são Hymeneo e Phileto;
texts.2ti.2.18: Os quaes se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a resurreição era já feita, e perverteram a fé de alguns.
texts.2ti.2.19: Todavia o fundamento de Deus fica firme, tendo este sello: O Senhor conhece os que são seus, e qualquer que nomeia o nome de Christo aparte-se da iniquidade.
texts.2ti.2.20: Ora n’uma grande casa não sómente ha vasos de oiro e de prata, mas tambem de pau e de barro, e uns para honra, outros, porém, para deshonra.
texts.2ti.2.21: De sorte que, se alguem se purificar d’estas coisas, será vaso para honra, sanctificado e idoneo para uso do Senhor, e preparado para toda a boa obra.
texts.2ti.2.22: Foge tambem dos desejos da mocidade; e segue a justiça, a fé, a caridade, e a paz com os que, com um coração puro, invocam o Senhor.
texts.2ti.2.23: E rejeita as questões loucas, e sem instrucção, sabendo que produzem contendas.
texts.2ti.2.24: E ao servo do Senhor não convém contender, mas sim ser manso para com todos, apto para ensinar e supportar os maus;
texts.2ti.2.25: Instruindo com mansidão os que resistem, se porventura Deus lhes der arrependimento para conhecerem a verdade,
texts.2ti.2.26: E tornarem a despertar, e se desprenderem dos laços do diabo, em que á vontade d’elle estão presos.
texts.2ti.3.1: Sabe, porém, isto, que nos ultimos dias sobrevirão tempos trabalhosos.
texts.2ti.3.2: Porque haverá homens amantes de si mesmos, avarentos, presumpçosos, soberbos, blasphemos, desobedientes a paes e mães, ingratos, profanos,
texts.2ti.3.3: Sem affecto natural, irreconciliaveis, calumniadores, incontinentes, crueis, sem amor para com os bons,
texts.2ti.3.4: Traidores, temerarios, orgulhosos, mais amantes dos deleites do que amantes de Deus,
texts.2ti.3.5: Tendo apparencia de piedade, mas negando a efficacia d’ella. D’estes affasta-te.
texts.2ti.3.6: Porque d’este numero são os que entram pelas casas, e levam captivas mulherinhas carregadas de peccados, levadas de varias concupiscencias;
texts.2ti.3.7: Que sempre aprendem, e nunca podem chegar ao conhecimento da verdade.
texts.2ti.3.8: E como Jannes e Jambres resistiram a Moysés, assim tambem estes resistem á verdade, homens corruptos de entendimento e reprobos emquanto á fé.
texts.2ti.3.9: Porém não irão mais avante; porque a todos será manifesto o seu desvario, como tambem o foi o d’aquelles.
texts.2ti.3.10: Tu, porém, tens seguido a minha doutrina, modo de viver, intenção, fé, longanimidade, caridade, paciencia,
texts.2ti.3.11: Perseguições, afflicções, taes quaes me aconteceram em Antioquia, em Iconio, e em Lystra: quantas perseguições soffri, e o Senhor de todas me livrou;
texts.2ti.3.12: E tambem todos os que piamente querem viver em Christo Jesus padecerão perseguições.
texts.2ti.3.13: Porém os homens maus e enganadores irão de mal para peior, enganando e sendo enganados.
texts.2ti.3.14: Tu, porém, fica nas coisas que aprendeste, e de que foste inteirado, sabendo de quem as tens aprendido;
texts.2ti.3.15: E que desde a tua meninice soubeste as sagradas lettras, as quaes podem fazer-te sabio para a salvação, pela fé que ha em Christo Jesus.
texts.2ti.3.16: Toda a Escriptura divinamente inspirada é proveitosa para ensinar, para redarguir, para corrigir, para instruir em justiça;
texts.2ti.3.17: Para que o homem de Deus seja perfeito e perfeitamente instruido para toda a boa obra.
texts.2ti.4.1: Conjuro-te pois diante de Deus, e do Senhor Jesus Christo, que ha de julgar os vivos e os mortos, na sua vinda e no seu reino,
texts.2ti.4.2: Que pregues a palavra, instes a tempo e fóra de tempo, redarguas, reprehendas, exhortes, com toda a longanimidade e doutrina.
texts.2ti.4.3: Porque virá tempo em que não soffrerão a sã doutrina; mas, tendo comichão nos ouvidos, amontoarão para si doutores conforme as suas proprias concupiscencias;
texts.2ti.4.4: E desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, e se tornarão ás fabulas.
texts.2ti.4.5: Porém tu vigia em todas as coisas, soffre as afflicções, faze a obra d’um evangelista, cumpre o teu ministerio.
texts.2ti.4.6: Porque a mim já agora me offereço por aspersão de sacrificio, e o tempo da minha partida está proximo.
texts.2ti.4.7: Combati o bom combate, acabei a carreira, guardei a fé.
texts.2ti.4.8: Pelo demais, a corôa da justiça está-me guardada, a qual o Senhor, justo juiz, me dará n’aquelle dia; e não sómente a mim, mas tambem a todos os que amarem a sua vinda.
texts.2ti.4.10: Porque Démas me desamparou, amando o presente seculo, e foi para Thessalonica, Crescente para Galacia, Tito para Dalmacia.
texts.2ti.4.11: Só Lucas está comigo. Toma Marcos, e tral-o comtigo, porque me é muito util para o ministerio.
texts.2ti.4.13: Quando vieres traze a capa que deixei em Troade, em casa de Carpo, e os livros, principalmente os pergaminhos.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alexandre, o latoeiro, occasionou-me muitos males; o Senhor lhe pague segundo as suas obras.
texts.2ti.4.15: Tu guarda-te tambem d’elle; porque resistiu muito ás nossas palavras.
texts.2ti.4.16: Ninguem me assistiu na minha primeira defeza, antes todos me desampararam. Oxalá isto lhes não seja imputado.
texts.2ti.4.17: Mas o Senhor assistiu-me e fortaleceu-me, para que por mim fosse cumprida a prégação, e todos os gentios a ouvissem; e fiquei livre da bocca do leão.
texts.2ti.4.18: E o Senhor me livrará de toda a má obra, e guardar-me-ha para o seu reino celestial; a quem seja gloria para todo o sempre. Amen.
texts.2ti.4.19: Sauda a Prisca e Aquila, e á casa de Onesiphoro.
texts.2ti.4.20: Erasto ficou em Corintho, e deixei Trophimo doente em Mileto.
texts.2ti.4.21: Procura vir antes do inverno. Eubulo, e Pudens, e Lino, e Claudia, e todos os irmãos te saudam.
texts.2ti.4.22: O Senhor Jesus Christo seja com o teu espirito. A graça seja comvosco. Amen.

texts.2ti.1.1: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
texts.2ti.1.2: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.2ti.1.3: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
texts.2ti.1.4: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
texts.2ti.1.5: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
texts.2ti.1.6: For which cause I put thee in remembrance, that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the imposition of my hands.
texts.2ti.1.7: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
texts.2ti.1.8: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
texts.2ti.1.9: Who hath saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before the world began;
texts.2ti.1.10: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
texts.2ti.1.11: To which I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
texts.2ti.1.12: For which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed to him against that day.
texts.2ti.1.13: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.1.14: That good thing which was committed to thee keep by the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.
texts.2ti.1.15: This thou knowest, that all they who are in Asia are turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
texts.2ti.1.16: The Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus; for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
texts.2ti.1.17: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
texts.2ti.1.18: The Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered to me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
texts.2ti.2.1: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.2.2: And the things that thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
texts.2ti.2.3: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
texts.2ti.2.4: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
texts.2ti.2.5: And if a man also striveth for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he striveth lawfully.
texts.2ti.2.6: The husbandman that laboreth must be first partaker of the fruits.
texts.2ti.2.7: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
texts.2ti.2.8: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
texts.2ti.2.9: In which I suffer trouble, as an evil-doer, even to bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
texts.2ti.2.10: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
texts.2ti.2.11: It is a faithful saying: For if we are dead with him, we shall also live with him:
texts.2ti.2.12: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
texts.2ti.2.13: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
texts.2ti.2.14: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they contend not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
texts.2ti.2.15: Study to show thyself approved to God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
texts.2ti.2.16: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase to more ungodliness.
texts.2ti.2.17: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;
texts.2ti.2.18: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
texts.2ti.2.19: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth firm, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
texts.2ti.2.20: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honor, and some to dishonor.
texts.2ti.2.21: If a man therefore will cleanse himself from these, he will be a vessel to honor, sanctified and meet for the master's use, and prepared to every good work.
texts.2ti.2.22: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
texts.2ti.2.23: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they gender contentions.
texts.2ti.2.24: And the servant of the Lord must not contend; but be gentle to all men, apt to teach, patient,
texts.2ti.2.25: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God perhaps will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth:
texts.2ti.2.26: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
texts.2ti.3.1: This know also, that in the last days perilous times will come.
texts.2ti.3.2: For men will be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
texts.2ti.3.3: Without natural affection, truce-breakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
texts.2ti.3.4: Traitors, heady, high-minded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
texts.2ti.3.5: Having a form of godliness, but denying its power: from such turn away.
texts.2ti.3.6: For of this sort are they who creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts;
texts.2ti.3.7: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
texts.2ti.3.8: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
texts.2ti.3.9: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly will be manifest to all men, as theirs also was.
texts.2ti.3.10: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, charity, patience,
texts.2ti.3.11: Persecutions, afflictions which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
texts.2ti.3.12: And all indeed that will live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
texts.2ti.3.13: But evil men and seducers will become worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
texts.2ti.3.14: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing from whom thou hast learned them;
texts.2ti.3.15: And that from a child thou hast known the sacred scriptures, which are able to make thee wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.3.16: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
texts.2ti.3.17: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished to all good works.
texts.2ti.4.1: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
texts.2ti.4.2: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and doctrine.
texts.2ti.4.3: For the time will come, when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts will they multiply to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
texts.2ti.4.4: And they will turn away their ears from the truth, and will be turned to fables.
texts.2ti.4.5: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
texts.2ti.4.6: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
texts.2ti.4.7: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
texts.2ti.4.8: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me at that day: and not to me only, but to all them also that love his appearing.
texts.2ti.4.9: Do thy diligence to come shortly to me:
texts.2ti.4.10: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and hath departed to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
texts.2ti.4.11: Luke only is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
texts.2ti.4.12: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
texts.2ti.4.13: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
texts.2ti.4.14: Alexander the copper-smith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
texts.2ti.4.15: Of whom be thou aware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
texts.2ti.4.16: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
texts.2ti.4.17: Notwithstanding, the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
texts.2ti.4.18: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me to his heavenly kingdom; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
texts.2ti.4.19: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
texts.2ti.4.20: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus I have left at Miletum sick.
texts.2ti.4.21: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
texts.2ti.4.22: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

texts.2ti.1.1: Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, according to promise of life, the [life] which [is] in Christ Jesus,
texts.2ti.1.2: to Timotheus, [my] beloved child: grace, mercy, peace, from God [the] Father, and Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.2ti.1.3: I am thankful to God, whom I serve from [my] forefathers with pure conscience, how unceasingly I have the remembrance of thee in my supplications night and day,
texts.2ti.1.4: earnestly desiring to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
texts.2ti.1.5: calling to mind the unfeigned faith which [has been] in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and in thy mother Eunice, and I am persuaded that in thee also.
texts.2ti.1.6: For which cause I put thee in mind to rekindle the gift of God which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
texts.2ti.1.7: For God has not given us a spirit of cowardice, but of power, and of love, and of wise discretion.
texts.2ti.1.8: Be not therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but suffer evil along with the glad tidings, according to the power of God;
texts.2ti.1.9: who has saved us, and has called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to [his] own purpose and grace, which [was] given to us in Christ Jesus before [the] ages of time,
texts.2ti.1.10: but has been made manifest now by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who has annulled death, and brought to light life and incorruptibility by the glad tidings;
texts.2ti.1.11: to which *I* have been appointed a herald and apostle and teacher of [the] nations.
texts.2ti.1.12: For which cause also I suffer these things; but I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep for that day the deposit I have entrusted to him.
texts.2ti.1.13: Have an outline of sound words, which [words] thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which [are] in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.1.14: Keep, by the Holy Spirit which dwells in us, the good deposit entrusted.
texts.2ti.1.15: Thou knowest this, that all who [are] in Asia, of whom is Phygellus and Hermogenes, have turned away from me.
texts.2ti.1.16: The Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he has often refreshed me, and has not been ashamed of my chain;
texts.2ti.1.17: but being in Rome sought me out very diligently, and found [me] --
texts.2ti.1.18: the Lord grant to him to find mercy from [the] Lord in that day -- and how much service he rendered in Ephesus *thou* knowest best.
texts.2ti.2.1: Thou therefore, my child, be strong in the grace which [is] in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.2.2: And the things thou hast heard of me in the presence of many witnesses, these entrust to faithful men, such as shall be competent to instruct others also.
texts.2ti.2.3: Take thy share in suffering as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
texts.2ti.2.4: No one going as a soldier entangles himself with the affairs of life, that he may please him who has enlisted him as a soldier.
texts.2ti.2.5: And if also any one contend [in the games], he is not crowned unless he contend lawfully.
texts.2ti.2.6: The husbandman must labour before partaking of the fruits.
texts.2ti.2.7: Think of what I say, for the Lord will give thee understanding in all things.
texts.2ti.2.8: Remember Jesus Christ raised from among [the] dead, of [the] seed of David, according to my glad tidings,
texts.2ti.2.9: in which I suffer even unto bonds as an evil-doer: but the word of God is not bound.
texts.2ti.2.10: For this cause I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that *they* also may obtain the salvation which [is] in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
texts.2ti.2.11: The word [is] faithful; for if we have died together with [him], we shall also live together;
texts.2ti.2.12: if we endure, we shall also reign together; if we deny, *he* also will deny us;
texts.2ti.2.13: if we are unfaithful, *he* abides faithful, for he cannot deny himself.
texts.2ti.2.14: Of these things put in remembrance, testifying earnestly before the Lord not to have disputes of words, profitable for nothing, to the subversion of the hearers.
texts.2ti.2.15: Strive diligently to present thyself approved to God, a workman that has not to be ashamed, cutting in a straight line the word of truth.
texts.2ti.2.16: But profane, vain babblings shun, for they will advance to greater impiety,
texts.2ti.2.17: and their word will spread as a gangrene; of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
texts.2ti.2.18: [men] who as to the truth have gone astray, saying that the resurrection has taken place already; and overthrow the faith of some.
texts.2ti.2.19: Yet the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal, [The] Lord knows those that are his; and, Let every one who names the name of [the] Lord withdraw from iniquity.
texts.2ti.2.20: But in a great house there are not only gold and silver vessels, but also wooden and earthen; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
texts.2ti.2.21: If therefore one shall have purified himself from these, [in separating himself from them], he shall be a vessel to honour, sanctified, serviceable to the Master, prepared for every good work.
texts.2ti.2.22: But youthful lusts flee, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those that call upon the Lord out of a pure heart.
texts.2ti.2.23: But foolish and senseless questionings avoid, knowing that they beget contentions.
texts.2ti.2.24: And a bondman of [the] Lord ought not to contend, but be gentle towards all; apt to teach; forbearing;
texts.2ti.2.25: in meekness setting right those who oppose, if God perhaps may sometime give them repentance to acknowledgment of [the] truth,
texts.2ti.2.26: and that they may awake up out of the snare of the devil, [who are] taken by him, for *his* will.
texts.2ti.3.1: But this know, that in [the] last days difficult times shall be there;
texts.2ti.3.2: for men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, evil speakers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, profane,
texts.2ti.3.3: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, of unsubdued passions, savage, having no love for what is good,
texts.2ti.3.4: traitors, headlong, of vain pretensions, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
texts.2ti.3.5: having a form of piety but denying the power of it: and from these turn away.
texts.2ti.3.6: For of these are they who are getting into houses, and leading captive silly women, laden with sins, led by various lusts,
texts.2ti.3.7: always learning, and never able to come to [the] knowledge of [the] truth.
texts.2ti.3.8: Now in the same manner in which Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, thus these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, found worthless as regards the faith.
texts.2ti.3.9: But they shall not advance farther; for their folly shall be completely manifest to all, as that of those also became.
texts.2ti.3.10: But *thou* hast been thoroughly acquainted with my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, endurance,
texts.2ti.3.11: persecutions, sufferings: what [sufferings] happened to me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what persecutions I endured; and the Lord delivered me out of all.
texts.2ti.3.12: And all indeed who desire to live piously in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
texts.2ti.3.13: But wicked men and juggling impostors shall advance in evil, leading and being led astray.
texts.2ti.3.14: But *thou*, abide in those things which thou hast learned, and [of which] thou hast been fully persuaded, knowing of whom thou hast learned [them];
texts.2ti.3.15: and that from a child thou hast known the sacred letters, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation, through faith which [is] in Christ Jesus.
texts.2ti.3.16: Every scripture [is] divinely inspired, and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for correction, for instruction in righteousness;
texts.2ti.3.17: that the man of God may be complete, fully fitted to every good work.
texts.2ti.4.1: I testify before God and Christ Jesus, who is about to judge living and dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom,
texts.2ti.4.2: proclaim the word; be urgent in season [and] out of season, convict, rebuke, encourage, with all longsuffering and doctrine.
texts.2ti.4.3: For the time shall be when they will not bear sound teaching; but according to their own lusts will heap up to themselves teachers, having an itching ear;
texts.2ti.4.4: and they will turn away their ear from the truth, and will have turned aside to fables.
texts.2ti.4.5: But *thou*, be sober in all things, bear evils, do [the] work of an evangelist, fill up the full measure of thy ministry.
texts.2ti.4.6: For *I* am already being poured out, and the time of my release is come.
texts.2ti.4.7: I have combated the good combat, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
texts.2ti.4.8: Henceforth the crown of righteousness is laid up for me, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will render to me in that day; but not only to me, but also to all who love his appearing.
